'''''Gift Giving Wookiees''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of five paintings, alongside ''[[Kashyyyk at Night]]'', ''[[Proud Wookiee]]'', ''[[Red Robed Wookiee]]'', and ''[[Wookiee with Pups]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pup (Wookiee)|pups]] offering each other a [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orb]]. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Gift Giving Wookiees'', alongside ''Kashyyyk at Night'', ''Proud Wookiee'', ''Red Robed Wookiee'' and ''Wookiee with Pups'', were supplied during the 2006 Wookiee Life Day festivities.
